## Velum Tattoo

A custom tattoo studio in Monterey Park, California. We create bespoke, permanent art — from fine-line to Japanese traditional — in a clean, welcoming environment.

- **Address:** 501 W Garvey Ave Ste 105, Monterey Park, CA 91754
- **Phone:** 740-708-5008
- **Email:** hello@velumtattoo.com
- **Hours:** Mon-Fri 12PM-5PM, Sat 12PM-3PM, Sun Closed
- **Styles:** Fine Line, Blackwork, Japanese, Realism, Traditional, Botanical, Ornamental, Script
- **Shop Minimum:** $150
